full_response:
> ℹ️ **Good to know before you go**:
> - Book Colosseum + Forum timed tickets well in advance; morning slots fill fast.
> - Reserve Trastevere dinner in advance — popular trattorie book up on weekends.
> - Expect security queues at St Peter's Basilica — allow extra time for screening.
> - St Peter's dome climb has a fee and limited capacity; book if wanted.
> - Leonardo Express tickets available at machines or online; validate schedules before travel.
> - Carry comfortable shoes, water, and sun protection — lots of outdoor walking.

# 3-day itinerary — Rome

## Day 1 — Arrival, Trevi & Trastevere dinner
- **15:00** — [Transfer to hotel](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Leonardo+da+Vinci%E2%80%93Fiumicino+Airport+Rome&destination=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five+Rome)
  - Leonardo Express train to Termini (~32 min) + walk to hotel. Price per person ~€14 (alternative: taxi ~€50).
  - 75 min · €14 per person

- **16:30** — [Check in / lodging (2 nights)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five+Rome)
  - Estimated cost per person for 2 nights in a central 4-star (approx. €260 double room total → ~€130 pp). Adjust if you have a booking confirmation.
  - 30 min · €130 per person

- **18:00** — [Trevi Fountain](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trevi+Fountain+Rome)
  - Outdoor visit; visit in the evening for atmosphere. Free entry.
  - 45 min · €0 per person

- **19:15** — [Dinner (evening in Trastevere)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trastevere+Rome)
  - Mid-range trattoria in Trastevere (~€30–50). Walk or short bus/taxi (walking preferred — ~25–35 min).
  - 135 min · €40 per person


_Day total: €184_

## Day 2 — Ancient Rome, shopping at Via del Corso, Pantheon
- **09:00** — [Colosseum (timed entry)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Colosseum+Rome)
  - Buy Colosseum + Roman Forum + Palatine timed ticket in advance (~€18 pp). Pick a morning slot. Walkable from the hotel (high walking pace).
  - 120 min · €18 per person

- **11:30** — [Roman Forum & Palatine Hill (included)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Roman+Forum+Rome)
  - Included in the Colosseum ticket — mostly outdoor ruins; wear good walking shoes.
  - 60 min · €0 per person

- **12:30** — Shopping stop (Via del Corso and nearby)
  - Central shopping street with a mix of mid-range shops, souvenir shops and boutiques. This satisfies the requested noon shopping stop.
  - 90 min · €0 per person

- **14:00** — Lunch during shopping
  - Mid-range lunch ~€15–25 (I used €20). Look for trattorie or café on/near Via del Corso.
  - 60 min · €20 per person

- **15:30** — [Pantheon (visit)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Pantheon+Rome)
  - Small entrance fee applied in recent years (estimate €5 pp). Check opening hours before you go.
  - 45 min · €5 per person

- **16:30** — [Coffee / Piazza Navona stroll](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Piazza+Navona+area+Rome)
  - Coffee ~€3. Pleasant outdoor stroll around the square.
  - 45 min · €3 per person

- **17:15** — Free time / aperitivo or explore Campo de' Fiori
  - Suggestions: grab an aperitivo, browse nearby streets and markets, or rest. No specific bookings needed.
  - 105 min · €0 per person

- **19:00** — [Dinner (historic centre)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Historic+Centre+Rome)
  - Mid-range dinner ~€30–50; I used €40.
  - 150 min · €40 per person


_Day total: €86_

## Day 3 — Vatican area (St Peter's), lunchtime in Trastevere, depart to FCO
- **09:00** — [St Peter's Basilica & Square](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=St+Peter%27s+Basilica+Rome)
  - Basilica entry is free; security queue applies. Dress code required. Optional dome climb is listed as a separate optional item.
  - 150 min · €0 per person

- **11:30** — Optional: St Peter's dome climb
  - Optional climb to the dome (~€10, estimate), narrow steps — allows better views. Add only if you'd like the extra climb.
  - 60 min · €10 per person

- **12:30** — [Lunch in Trastevere (riverside)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trastevere+Rome)
  - Mid-range lunch in Trastevere (~€20–30). Return by walking or short bus/tram; walking is scenic along the river.
  - 90 min · €25 per person

- **14:30** — [Return to hotel to pack / relax](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five+Rome)
  - Time to collect luggage and final packing. No cost.
  - 90 min · €0 per person

- **17:00** — [Transfer to airport](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five+Rome&destination=Leonardo+da+Vinci%E2%80%93Fiumicino+Airport+Rome)
  - Leonardo Express from Termini to FCO (~32 min) + transfer time to Termini. Price per person ~€14. Scheduled to arrive at the airport ~18:30 to allow a 3-hour buffer before your stated end time of 21:30. Alternative: taxi (~€50).
  - 90 min · €14 per person


_Day total: €49_

**Total: €319 per person**

# 3-day itinerary — Rome

## Day 1 — Arrival, Trevi & Trastevere dinner
- **15:00** — [Transfer to hotel](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Leonardo+da+Vinci%E2%80%93Fiumicino+Airport+Rome&destination=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five+Rome)
  - Leonardo Express train to Termini (~32 min) + walk to hotel. Price per person ~€14 (alternative: taxi ~€50).
  - 75 min · €14 per person

- **16:30** — [Check in / lodging (2 nights)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five+Rome)
  - Estimated cost per person for 2 nights in a central 4-star (approx. €260 double room total → ~€130 pp). Adjust if you have a booking confirmation.
  - 30 min · €130 per person

- **18:00** — [Trevi Fountain](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trevi+Fountain+Rome)
  - Outdoor visit; visit in the evening for atmosphere. Free entry.
  - 45 min · €0 per person

- **19:15** — [Dinner (evening in Trastevere)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trastevere+Rome)
  - Mid-range trattoria in Trastevere (~€30–50). Walk or short bus/taxi (walking preferred — ~25–35 min).
  - 135 min · €40 per person


_Day total: €184_

## Day 2 — Ancient Rome, shopping at Via del Corso, Pantheon
- **09:00** — [Colosseum (timed entry)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Colosseum+Rome)
  - Buy Colosseum + Roman Forum + Palatine timed ticket in advance (~€18 pp). Pick a morning slot. Walkable from the hotel (high walking pace).
  - 120 min · €18 per person

- **11:30** — [Roman Forum & Palatine Hill (included)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Roman+Forum+Rome)
  - Included in the Colosseum ticket — mostly outdoor ruins; wear good walking shoes.
  - 60 min · €0 per person

- **12:30** — Shopping stop (Via del Corso and nearby)
  - Central shopping street with a mix of mid-range shops, souvenir shops and boutiques. This satisfies the requested noon shopping stop.
  - 90 min · €0 per person

- **14:00** — Lunch during shopping
  - Mid-range lunch ~€15–25 (I used €20). Look for trattorie or café on/near Via del Corso.
  - 60 min · €20 per person

- **15:30** — [Pantheon (visit)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Pantheon+Rome)
  - Small entrance fee applied in recent years (estimate €5 pp). Check opening hours before you go.
  - 45 min · €5 per person

- **16:30** — [Coffee / Piazza Navona stroll](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Piazza+Navona+area+Rome)
  - Coffee ~€3. Pleasant outdoor stroll around the square.
  - 45 min · €3 per person

- **17:15** — Free time / aperitivo or explore Campo de' Fiori
  - Suggestions: grab an aperitivo, browse nearby streets and markets, or rest. No specific bookings needed.
  - 105 min · €0 per person

- **19:00** — [Dinner (historic centre)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Historic+Centre+Rome)
  - Mid-range dinner ~€30–50; I used €40.
  - 150 min · €40 per person


_Day total: €86_

## Day 3 — Vatican area (St Peter's), lunchtime in Trastevere, depart to FCO
- **09:00** — [St Peter's Basilica & Square](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=St+Peter%27s+Basilica+Rome)
  - Basilica entry is free; security queue applies. Dress code required. Optional dome climb is listed as a separate optional item.
  - 150 min · €0 per person

- **11:30** — Optional: St Peter's dome climb
  - Optional climb to the dome (~€10, estimate), narrow steps — allows better views. Add only if you'd like the extra climb.
  - 60 min · €10 per person

- **12:30** — [Lunch in Trastevere (riverside)](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Trastevere+Rome)
  - Mid-range lunch in Trastevere (~€20–30). Return by walking or short bus/tram; walking is scenic along the river.
  - 90 min · €25 per person

- **14:30** — [Return to hotel to pack / relax](https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five+Rome)
  - Time to collect luggage and final packing. No cost.
  - 90 min · €0 per person

- **17:00** — [Transfer to airport](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Hotel+55+Fifty-Five+Rome&destination=Leonardo+da+Vinci%E2%80%93Fiumicino+Airport+Rome)
  - Leonardo Express from Termini to FCO (~32 min) + transfer time to Termini. Price per person ~€14. Scheduled to arrive at the airport ~18:30 to allow a 3-hour buffer before your stated end time of 21:30. Alternative: taxi (~€50).
  - 90 min · €14 per person


_Day total: €49_

**Total: €319 per person**
